subject: planner: make index merge union case aware of order property (#49632)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its first parent, focusing on planner changes. The change introduces an “undetermined” OR-IndexMerge access-path form (`PartialAlternativeIndexPaths`) and converges it during skyline pruning to pick per-DNF alternatives that satisfy non-empty order properties (and recomputes IndexMerge selectivity after convergence) while deferring OR-filter retention decisions. No remaining Blocker/High correctness/semantics issues found in the touched planner logic.
